profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Amplify
profile.summary:
Here’s my short story. When I was a kid, I loved math because I enjoyed taking on new challenges and using my logical thinking to solve them. The younger version of myself dreamed of becoming a math teacher because I wanted to share the joy of tackling various problems. Little did I know, I would later be introduced to the thrilling field of coding through a German exchange student who had been with us for several years. After that, I began to dive deeper into the world of programming, picking up various languages, tools, and concepts at the Rochester Institute of Technology.

Since then, I have been constantly learning new areas of technology, including both front-end and back-end tools and concepts. I have applied this growing knowledge to contribute to several full-stack projects at work. These include enhancing grade-appropriate themes for students’ experiences in Desmos Classroom, addressing keyboard and screen reader accessibility issues to ensure compliance with WCAG standards, and supporting the marketing team by collecting data and logging xAPI events, among other tasks.

I truly enjoy continuously contributing to the improvement and expansion of project functionalities, as well as troubleshooting and resolving bugs to ensure the reliability and quality of our work.

Professional Experience
- Version Control (GitHub)
- Agile Methodology
- AWS Services

Programming Experience
- JavaScript & TypeScript & ReactJS
- HTML & CSS & SASS & Stylus
- Python
- Java
- C#
- PHP
- C

I am looking forward to problem-solving with other people who share the same joy in developing software, and I am eager to learn their unique ways of finding solutions by which to help improve our technology and the world.
